name: io.github.tonyyang0504/github-mcp
description: GitHub (social): me, read_comments, delete, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitHub personal access token (fine-grained: repository permission Discussions read / write on the repositories used; classic: repo or public_repo scope) sent as 'Authorization: bearer TOKEN' (https://docs.github.com/en/graphql/guides/forming-calls-with-graphql).
